a14.title: Solitaire Charm Huggies
a14.descriptionHtml:
One stone below a chunky hoop. Each earring is a polished gold tone huggie of about 13mm with a thick, flat-faced band; a chunky square gold tone tube is threaded on its base, and a round clear cubic zirconia of about 6.5mm hangs below it in four fine claws.

STYLING TIP: Pair them with the Petite Pear Solitaire Necklace.

Details

  • Hoop: Approximately 13mm, a thick polished band with a hinged snap
  • Charm: A square gold tone tube of about 4mm threaded on the hoop, with a round clear cubic zirconia, approximately 6.5mm, in four claws on one small ring
  • Length: Approximately 24mm from the top of the hoop to the bottom of the stone
  • Sold as: One pair
  • Finish: Polished gold tone

Care

Keep it dry and away from perfume and harsh chemicals. Wipe with a soft dry cloth and store it flat in its pouch.

You will receive your piece in a Naira Petite box.

a15.title: Pave Open Heart Studs
a15.descriptionHtml:
A heart drawn in light. Each stud is a bold open heart of about 20mm in polished gold tone, its broad outline set with two rows of tiny clear cubic zirconia, with the centre left open.

STYLING TIP: Pair them with the Pearl Heart Layered Necklace.

Details

  • Size: Approximately 20mm across and 19mm tall
  • Stones: Two rows of tiny clear cubic zirconia round the outline
  • Fitting: Stud
  • Sold as: One pair
  • Finish: Polished gold tone
  • Material: Stainless steel, as on the supplier's card

Care

Keep it dry and away from perfume and harsh chemicals. Wipe with a soft dry cloth and store it flat in its pouch.

You will receive your piece in a Naira Petite box.
